prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presents following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left, with resulting right shoulder pain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the pattern of complaints fits what would be expected from this type of impact. Over the course of 18 visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, graded home exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and care tapered to discharge. Our assessment relies largely on the patient's own description of pain and functional limitation, as range of motion testing and orthopedic provocative maneuvers were within normal limits, and imaging of the shoulder showed no acute abnormality. The patient reports a remote minor strain to the same region in the past, which resolved completely without lasting deficit. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicated or repeated entries. Prognosis is good, and the patient is discharged to self-directed exercise with return to usual activities as tolerated.
